text:
Leonora Neuffer Bilger received the Francis P. Garvan–John M. Olin Medal in 1953. The Iowa State finding aid and a Kiddle recipient list both place her in 1953, and the Wikipedia Garvan–Olin list snippet I saw appears to show 1954, which looks like an offset. The shared note's alternative of 1947 doesn't match any source I found.

CONFIDENCE: 85
